metadata.name: парк Лесотехнической академии
metadata.note: Park geometry, footprints, paths, water and green areas are from OpenStreetMap. Building heights are extruded only when tagged in OSM or estimated from OSM floor count, clearly labelled as estimates. Buildings with unknown height remain footprint-only. Facade colours are shown only when explicitly tagged; other facades use a neutral schematic massing colour. Tree crowns remain illustrative where OSM maps only a point.
